known_caveats: 1 of 316 candidate-NCT pairs (cand_9bac9d1f2e24fcf61a8e / NCT07741617, 'Iparomlimab and tuvonralimab (QL1706) + lenvatinib') shows a field-level divergence: Build A's intervention-field substring test did not match the registry's paraphrased wording ('...in combination with...' vs the candidate name's '+'), leaving those fields UNKNOWN, while Build B's token-overlap test matched. Resolved in favor of Build B's evidence-grounded, frozen-M2-supported values per the reconciliation policy (prefer non-UNKNOWN when the other build is UNKNOWN); this is a genuine algorithmic difference between the two independent matchers, not a defect in either.

M2/M5/M6v2 inputs for this milestone were not present in the git-tracked artifact branches (only checksum/manifest files are committed); the underlying per-version JSON and ledgers were fetched from the corresponding GitHub Releases (djbm10/Biotech-Asset-Valuation-Engine) and verified by re-deriving 316/316 identical candidate-NCT pair coverage between two independently written mappers.
